paths.description: Logged-out homepage and authentication entry, the primary public entry and consent experience.
Narrow logged-out entry, representing mobile installation/sign-in and responsive consent.
Public profile/feed template, representing publicly readable account content and repeated scrolling.
Terms of Service content template, representing long-form policy content.
Unknown route, representing HTTP/routing failure and recovery behavior.

findings.summary: The cookie prompt obscures primary content on every public surface.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots show a fixed banner consuming the bottom 153 px; at 360x800 it occupies roughly 276 px and covers the sign-in action. The TOS and profile pages are also covered.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-blocking consent control that preserves access to the primary task, with an equally prominent refusal action and persistent settings access.

findings.summary: Consent and authentication overlays are custom role-based structures rather than native dialog/popover primitives.
findings.evidence: DOM probe found no <dialog> or [popover] despite the fixed consent surface and the modal authentication surface shown after an unknown route redirect.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for modal authentication and popover or a non-modal region for transient consent UI; preserve native focus, Escape and top-layer behavior.

findings.summary: State and route changes do not expose evidence of View Transition use.
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM/CSS and interaction evidence showed ordinary instant SPA state changes and no ::view-transition rules; the platform API exists but was not used by the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-document View Transitions to route/tab/modal state changes, with reduced-motion behavior.

findings.summary: The logged-out home misses Core Web Vitals and interactivity targets.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 12.2 s, CLS 0.147, TBT 440 ms and TTI 12.7 s (performance score 0.55). The raw-CDP trace still measured LCP 2.40 s and 84 ms TBT, showing high run variance but a fragile load.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the actual LCP element, render the logged-out shell from HTML, and delay non-critical authentication and feature bundles.

findings.summary: The logged-out mobile page shifts materially during load.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 layout observer recorded CLS 0.135 across three shifts around 1.58-2.11 s; Lighthouse independently measured CLS 0.147 and two large shifts.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve stable space for authentication providers and consent UI, and align fallback/font metrics before late content appears.

findings.summary: JavaScript blocks the main thread during startup.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 2.5 s of main-thread work, 1.7 s JS execution and 440 ms TBT; CDP trace recorded three long tasks up to 84.9 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Break startup work into prioritized tasks and avoid initializing logged-in-only modules on the logged-out route.

findings.summary: The simple logged-out page requires an oversized dependency graph.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 105 requests and 2.61 MB transferred, including 66 scripts and 1.83 MB script transfer. Several low-priority route bundles took about 1.2 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Ship a minimal logged-out entry bundle, retain defer for parser scripts, and load identity and product modules only after intent.

findings.summary: The logged-out route ships hundreds of KiB of unused JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 639 KiB unused JS: main was 50% unused, vendor 47%, Google Identity 75%, and modules.common 98.8%.
findings.suggestedFix: Split logged-out/auth code from feed, Grok, chat and logged-in modules; import optional dependencies only after the triggering action.

findings.summary: Profile media includes images without alternative text.
findings.evidence: The image probe found 10 of 32 images without alt, including the profile banner and multiple post/video thumbnails. Some may be decorative, but post media requires a text alternative when meaningful.
findings.suggestedFix: Require author alt text for meaningful post media and use alt="" for intentionally decorative imagery.

findings.summary: The viewport explicitly disables user zoom.
findings.evidence: The live viewport meta contains maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=0; Lighthouse fails the meta-viewport accessibility audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions so pinch zoom remains available.

findings.summary: The logged-out page emits console and CSP errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured a Google FedCM AbortError, two identity-provider errors, and a blocked inline script caused by the page CSP.
findings.suggestedFix: Treat expected identity cancellation as a handled state and align inline bootstrap execution with the nonce-based CSP.

findings.summary: Profile images lack intrinsic dimensions and responsive delivery.
findings.evidence: 27 of 32 images lacked width/height, 11 lacked srcset, five were oversized, and 27 used legacy PNG/JPEG delivery.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio and responsive srcset/sizes for avatars, banners and post media; negotiate AVIF/WebP where useful.

findings.summary: Browser inspector and lifecycle hygiene are not clean.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported a CSP inspector issue and a BFCache failure (SharedWorkerWithNoActiveClient), alongside legacy JavaScript estimated at 54 KiB.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove avoidable inspector issues, modernize bundle targets, and review shared-worker lifecycle for BFCache compatibility.

findings.summary: Several first-party cookies use weak transport and cross-site settings.
findings.evidence: Cookie audit found six cookies flagged insecure by the primitive: g_state and two __cuid cookies were not Secure; all six were SameSite=None; guest_id and __cuid persist about 396-400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark every HTTPS cookie Secure, use Lax/Strict unless cross-site behavior is essential, and reduce identifier lifetimes.

findings.summary: Most logged-out network traffic goes to additional origins before user intent.
findings.evidence: HAR attributed 91/105 requests and 2.51/2.61 MB to origins classified as third party relative to x.com, mostly abs.twimg.com, plus Google and Apple identity scripts. Tracker matching found no known analytics tracker.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer identity-provider and optional product traffic until chosen; document and minimize every cross-origin request on the logged-out route.

findings.summary: Defensive headers are incomplete and CSP still permits unsafe inline styling/script patterns.
findings.evidence: Headers include HSTS, nosniff and X-Frame-Options DENY, but omit Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy. CSP includes unsafe-inline and produced a blocked-script inspector error.
findings.suggestedFix: Set explicit Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, remove unnecessary unsafe-inline allowances, and keep nonce/hash authorization consistent.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are inconsistent on the public entry surface.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found no canonical URL. robots.txt advertises /sitemap.xml, but fetching that endpoint returned the SPA HTML document rather than an XML sitemap. Generic User-agent:* is disallowed, while Googlebot/Bingbot have selective access.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid XML sitemap, add self-referential canonicals to public templates, and keep robots directives aligned with intended public discovery.

findings.summary: The logged-out home is mostly unavailable to no-JavaScript clients.
findings.evidence: Discoverability comparison found only 22% rendered-word coverage in raw HTML; title, h1 and meta description were absent from raw content. The public profile performed much better at 93%, showing the gap is template-specific.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the logged-out heading, explanation and authentication links/form fallback, then enhance them with JavaScript.

findings.summary: The app advertises installability but has no service-worker offline fallback.
findings.evidence: A complete manifest with standalone display and shortcuts is linked, but the runtime probe found no service-worker controller or registration.
findings.suggestedFix: Register a service worker with a small offline shell and explicit offline/error messaging for already-visited public content.

findings.summary: Unknown routes are converted into an authentication prompt instead of a truthful recoverable 404.
findings.evidence: A deliberately missing URL redirected to /i/jf/onboarding/...mode=login and displayed “See what’s happening,” with no not-found explanation or route recovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 status and a clear not-found page with Home, Search and Back actions; do not imply authentication will resolve an invalid route.

findings.summary: Public feed imagery is not consistently resolution- or format-optimized.
findings.evidence: Image probe found five oversized images, 11 without responsive sources, and 27 legacy-format assets among 32 images.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive variants near display size and modern formats, retaining originals only when needed.

findings.summary: The logged-out page spends a disproportionate resource budget before interaction.
findings.evidence: A text-and-authentication surface transferred 2.61 MB across 105 requests; 2.51 MB and 91 requests were cross-origin by host classification, with 66 scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt a logged-out page-weight budget, delay identity/product integrations until intent, and remove nonessential preloaded route code.

taskList.title: Ship a server-rendered, minimal logged-out shell and defer optional product/identity bundles
Restore user zoom and reserve stable layout space
Replace the obstructive custom consent surface with compact semantic UI
Harden cookies, CSP and browser policy headers
Optimize profile media delivery and require meaningful alt text
Return truthful recoverable 404 states and add an offline fallback
Repair canonical and sitemap discovery signals
Clean console, inspector and lifecycle errors
Add reduced-motion-aware View Transitions for major state changes
